concept: ECR: private image registry with scanning and lifecycle policies
tests: Choosing the AWS service to store, scan, and automatically clean up Docker images.
expected: Amazon ECR — managed private registry with image scanning and lifecycle policies, natively integrated with ECS, EKS, and Lambda. Triggers: "private registry", "scan for vulnerabilities", "automatic expiry of old images".
why_not: S3 with versioning stores objects without OCI registry semantics; CodeArtifact is for packages (npm, pip, Maven), not container images; Docker Hub is a third-party service, not AWS.
